name: write-methods
description: Use this skill when the user wants a methods write-up of an analysis project — either a consolidated, living account of the whole project or a focused explanation of one stage or result. Its primary purpose is human-agent alignment: reconstruct the chain from data to choices to key results, surface the challengeable assumptions, and ask the user to confirm the riskiest ones. Companion to `/new-analysis-plan` and `/new-analysis-implement`.
